description:
D-Day, June 6, 1944. The largest invasion in human history — and the day ordinary nineteen-year-olds changed the world forever.

I have told many stories on this channel, but this one stays with me. From the fake army that fooled Hitler to the Rangers climbing the cliffs of Pointe du Hoc, from Eisenhower's secret resignation letter to the Fuhrer asleep while his empire bled — this is the full story of the Longest Day.

If these stories move you, subscribe to Echoes of History. Every week, we bring the past back to life, one untold story at a time.
